detail.longDescription: Tines 3B is the single, secure environment for your most important agents, apps, and automation. Build with AI, from anywhere. Code runs isolated and credentials stay protected. Everything you ship is fully auditable and monitored from one place. Tines 3B is code-first and AI-native, built to help you move fast without compromising on security. Explore Edition is available today and gives you access to 3 live workflows with unlimited users, spaces, and connectors.
